criteria.statement: Environment unit list, create, and update use signed environment/get-details reads and perform no REST request or HTTP fallback.
environment/get-details authorizes environments:read for the signer and returns environment targeting, updated_at, and explicit or resolved implicit deployment units in a signed ContextVM result.
Adding a Bahia-managed Compose unit with a complete-set environment update preserves every pre-existing unit by Key, including git_source.

Complete-set updates send expected_updated_at; a -32009 conflict triggers a fresh signed read and merge, succeeds within three attempts when contention clears, and reports a clear error after three conflicts.

A generic app can add a new Bahia-managed Compose unit to one edge-01-docker-shaped environment, target that unit in deploy preview and deploy intent creation, and create a route-attach intent whose plan targets the same unit.
